burn.name: Burn
burn.desc: Lose 6% max HP at end of each of its turns.

chill.name: Chill
chill.desc: Lose 4% max HP/turn and AGI -1 stage (x0.75).

wilt.name: Wilt
wilt.desc: Lose 4% max HP/turn and ATK -1 stage.

hollow_touch.name: Hollow Touch
hollow_touch.desc: Max SP -10% per stack (max 3). Persists until Warm Glow / Ward Charm Strike / a Lantern Post.

thinned.name: Thinned
thinned.desc: Far Shore only: ATK/DEF x0.8 (Daigo without a Ward Charm).

calm.name: Calm
calm.desc: Enemy only: will not attack. Ends if damaged (Mood -30). Restless: leaves after 3 enemy turns.

fading.name: Fading
fading.desc: Mio only: Lumen -3 per turn; Lumen skills cost +50% SP.

marked.name: Marked
marked.desc: Next hit on this target is a critical.

exposed.name: Exposed
exposed.desc: Takes +20% damage from the next hit.

guard.name: Guard
guard.desc: Damage /2 until the start of its next turn (RM rule).

bound.name: Bound
bound.desc: Silk binds: AGI -2 stages, cannot Shift/Possess. Cut by Flame or Gale hit.

nameless.name: Nameless
nameless.desc: Name-Eater grab: a Name Fragment is held. Returned on defeat/Send; lost if not freed in 2 turns. Target loses Remember/Hum.

possessed.name: Possessed
possessed.desc: Bond Form: ATK/MAT x1.3, damage taken x0.85, Attack = signature skill.

gathering.name: Gathering
gathering.desc: Enemy tell: next action is the announced heavy skill. Cancelled by Stun/Dazed(100%)/Unveiled.

unveiled.name: Unveiled
unveiled.desc: Veil Points reached 0: loses next action, takes x1.5 damage, Parley Mood gains x2, Send allowed. 2 turns.

enrage.name: Enraged
enrage.desc: Soft enrage: +8% damage per stack (max 8) after the boss's enrage turn.

heart_break.name: Heart Break
heart_break.desc: Boss at <=30% HP (story bosses): Send/Parley open. Boss patterns shift to Desperation.

dish_full.name: Dish Full
dish_full.desc: Kappa: Tide skills heal 5%. Removed by Gale hit (becomes Dish Spilled).

expectant.name: Expectant
expectant.desc: Kaoppa waits for a bow: next hit +25% unless a Stand/Offer was used.

stilled.name: Stilled
stilled.desc: Garden Guardian: damage x0.1 and cannot be Unveiled while any Garden Pillar stands.

counter_ready.name: Counter Ready
counter_ready.desc: Tengu counters any attack on it next turn (x1.4).
